fields.evidence: FUN_08000264 reads 8B at SRAM 0x0E000000 (save offset 0x00) and compares against the ROM magic word; FUN_08000304 writes the 8B magic from _DAT_08000350 to 0x0E000000 on format; baseline bytes 0x00-0x07 are 41 42 42 41 43 4B 55 50.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Reserved 8 bytes between magic and allocation table; zero in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000304 zero-fills all 256 SRAM sectors (0x100 x 0x80B writes from 0x0E000000) then writes only the 8B magic, leaving save offsets 0x08-0x0F zero as seen in baseline; no reader of this range observed in decomp (consistent with reserved header or two freed table entries).
fields.name: header_reserved

fields.description: Allocation-table entry 0, valid flag: bank 0 (system block) is allocated.
fields.evidence: FUN_080003b4 writes entry byte0=0x01 on allocation; FUN_08000360/FUN_080004f8/FUN_08000578 match entries with byte0!=0 and byte1==bank id; baseline offset 0x10 is 0x01.
fields.name: bank0_valid

fields.evidence: FUN_080003b4 stores param_1 (bank id) into entry byte1; wrappers match (byte)pc[1]==param_1; bank id 0 is bound by FUN_0801902c (FUN_080004f8(0,0,0x40,...)); baseline offset 0x11 is 0x00.
fields.name: bank0_bank_id

fields.description: Allocation-table entry 0, start sector 4: bank 0 data lives at SRAM 0x0E000200 (file offset 0x200).
fields.evidence: FUN_080003b4 writes the allocated sector into entry byte2 via FUN_0800065c; FUN_080004f8/FUN_08000578 compute SRAM address sector*0x80+offset+0x0E000000; baseline offset 0x12 is 0x04, contiguous with bank 1 at sector 5.
fields.name: bank0_start_sector

fields.description: Allocation-table entry 0, sector count 1 (0x80B reserved, 0x40B used).
fields.evidence: FUN_080003b4 writes (size+0x7F)>>7 into entry byte3 and I/O bounds-checks offset+size<=count*0x80; FUN_0801902c allocates bank 0 with FUN_080003b4(0,0x80) and reads 0x40B; baseline offset 0x13 is 0x01.
fields.name: bank0_sector_count

fields.description: Allocation-table entry 1, valid flag: bank 1 (main data block) is allocated.
fields.evidence: Same allocator/matcher mechanism as bank0_valid (FUN_080003b4/FUN_08000360/FUN_080004f8/FUN_08000578); baseline offset 0x14 is 0x01.
fields.name: bank1_valid

fields.description: Allocation-table entry 1, bank id 1 (main data block).
fields.evidence: Bank id 1 is bound by FUN_080190d4 (FUN_080003b4(1,_DAT_08019114), FUN_08000578(1,0,size,...)); baseline offset 0x15 is 0x01.
fields.name: bank1_bank_id

fields.description: Allocation-table entry 1, start sector 5: bank 1 data lives at SRAM 0x0E000280 (file offset 0x280).
fields.evidence: Sector/count addressing per FUN_080004f8/FUN_08000578 (sector*0x80+0x0E000000); baseline offset 0x16 is 0x05, immediately following bank 0 (sector 4, 1 sector).
fields.name: bank1_start_sector

fields.description: Allocation-table entry 1, sector count 39 (0x1380B reserved for main data).
fields.evidence: Entry byte3 semantics per FUN_080003b4 ((size+0x7F)>>7); baseline offset 0x17 is 0x27=39, and 5+39=44 exactly equals bank 2 start sector, proving the entry.
fields.name: bank1_sector_count

fields.description: Allocation-table entry 2, valid flag: bank 2 (persistent word + arena) is allocated.
fields.evidence: Same allocator/matcher mechanism as bank0_valid (FUN_080003b4/FUN_08000360/FUN_080004f8/FUN_08000578); baseline offset 0x18 is 0x01.
fields.name: bank2_valid

fields.description: Allocation-table entry 2, bank id 2 (persistent word block).
fields.evidence: Bank id 2 is bound by FUN_08015578 (FUN_080003b4(2,_DAT_080155bc), FUN_08000578/FUN_080004f8(2,0,4,...)); baseline offset 0x19 is 0x02.
fields.name: bank2_bank_id

fields.description: Allocation-table entry 2, start sector 44: bank 2 data lives at SRAM 0x0E001600 (file offset 0x1600).
fields.evidence: Sector addressing per FUN_080004f8/FUN_08000578; baseline offset 0x1A is 0x2C=44, exactly bank 1 start (5) plus bank 1 count (39).
fields.name: bank2_start_sector

fields.description: Allocation-table entry 2, sector count 182 (0x5B00B reserved arena).
fields.evidence: Entry byte3 semantics per FUN_080003b4; baseline offset 0x1B is 0xB6=182, and 44+182=226 stays within the 252 allocatable sectors (4-255).
fields.name: bank2_sector_count

fields.description: Bank 0 data extent (sector 4, 0x80B); first 0x40B are the system/config mirror loaded at boot, rest reserved.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801902c allocates bank 0 via FUN_080003b4(0,0x80) then loads 0x40B with FUN_080004f8(0,0,0x40,RAM+0x1C) where RAM base is _DAT_08019070 (same base as _DAT_08017b34 in boot FUN_08017ad4); whole sector zero in baseline (fresh save), so sub-field semantics are unconfirmed.
fields.name: bank0_system_block

fields.description: Bank 1 data extent (sectors 5-43, 39*0x80=0x1380B); main save payload stored/loaded as one blob at init.
fields.evidence: FUN_080190d4 allocates bank 1 via FUN_080003b4(1,_DAT_08019114) then stores/loads the full struct with FUN_08000578(1,0,size,...) (fresh) into the static RAM struct at _DAT_08019110; all zeros in baseline (fresh save), so inner gameplay struct layout is unconfirmed.
fields.name: bank1_data_block

fields.description: First persistent word of bank 2 (sector 44); zeroed on first init, otherwise loaded to EWRAM.
fields.evidence: FUN_08015578 memsets the EWRAM word at _DAT_080155b4, zeroes it and stores with FUN_08000578(2,0,4,...) when bank 2 is missing, else loads with FUN_080004f8(2,0,4,...); baseline file offset 0x1600 is 0x00000000.
fields.name: system_counter

fields.description: Remainder of the bank 2 sector reservation (sectors 44-225 minus the first word); untouched zeros in baseline.
fields.evidence: Descriptor entry 2 reserves 0xB6=182 sectors from sector 44 (file 0x1600-0x70FF) per FUN_080003b4/FUN_08000578 bounds (count*0x80); only the first 4B are touched by FUN_08015578; baseline 0x1604-0x70FF all zero.
fields.name: bank2_reserved
